response.query: What are the top creative and quality trends in Humanities, Literature, and Arts based on our discussion of assessment tools, evaluation methods, industry engagement, and pilot study strategies?
response.answer: Top trends include interdisciplinary collaboration, innovative assessment methods, and increased focus on student engagement through creative arts. Pilot studies emphasize staff empowerment and research culture development.

results.title: STRATEGY 2021-2026
results.content: 5.2.4 Enhance collaborations and create new research networks Tasks:  Organize grand scale conference, series of meetings, workshops to promote collaboration between academic institutions  Organize and fund meetings, workshops to identify possible collaborations  Establish a fund to support attendance of international conferences by EHU staff  Promote OSUN-supported activities inclusion into EHU Indicators:  Organized conferences, meetings and workshops ‒ Annual targets  Funding is provided for organization of meetings, workshops to identify possible collaborations ‒ Due by: Q2, 2023  Attendance in international conferences supported via individual research “package” ‒ Annual target  OSUN-supported activities implemented ‒ Annual target In charge:  Communication and Marketing Unit  Academic department of Social Sciences  Academic Departments of Humanities and Arts  Center for Strategic Planning and Development Key developments during 2021-2022:  11 initiatives of academic collaboration in nature (joined project applications, visits, workshops, summer schools) took place  1 international monograph; 2 parts of international monographs; 5 international articles; 50 participations in international conferences  11 minor OSUN-supported activities being implemented  Regulations on the EHU (Individual 20 Faculty and Institutional) participation in the OSUN activities and projects was prepared 5.2.5.
